finalists.label: Choroideremia
finalists.why: Complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in superotemporal region and flat rod electroretinogram support this candidate.

finalists.label: Choroidal dystrophy
finalists.why: Superotemporal zones showing hypofluorescence and complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in superotemporal region with no evidence against support this candidate.

finalists.label: Stargardt Disease
finalists.why: Few yellow spots present and superotemporal zones showing hypofluorescence with no evidence against support this candidate, but it does not account for night blindness since childhood.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in the superotemporal region, along with a flat rod electroretinogram, decided the final comparison in favor of Choroideremia.
